    MESSAGE _ENGLISH VERSION_






    Current Report No. 44/2026


    Date: November 9th, 2026


    Subject: Transactions in KRUK S.A. shares


    Legal basis: Art. 70.1 of the Public Offering Act


    Text of the report:


    Acting in accordance with Art. 70.1 of the Act on Public Offering,
    Conditions Governing the Introduction of Financial Instruments to
    Organised Trading, and Public Companies of July 29th 2005, the
    Management Board of KRUK S.A. _the "Company"_ announces that it was
    notified by The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., with the content attached to
    this Report.
